# Lisbon 5-Day Relaxed Trip Plan

A slow-paced Lisbon itinerary for **2025-08-14 to 2025-08-18** with **EUR 900** excluding flights, built around **public transport**, **one museum per day max**, and **one beach afternoon**. I’m assuming a comfortable mid-range style with simple lunches, a mix of trams/metro/ferries, and one or two paid attractions per day.

# Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary

## Day 1: Historic Core and Riverfront
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Baixa and Rossio stroll; ride Tram 28 only if queues are light, otherwise use walking + metro.
- **Afternoon:** Alfama wander with viewpoints at Portas do Sol and Santa Luzia.
- **Dinner:** Simple seafood or petiscos near the river in Cais do Sodré.
- **Budget note:** Low-cost day; mostly walking and transit.

## Day 2: Belém Highlights
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Belém Tower exterior and waterfront walk; visit Jerónimos Monastery if you want one major monument stop.
- **Afternoon:** Pastéis de Belém, then MAAT area or riverside relaxation.
- **Dinner:** Return to central Lisbon for a casual meal in Chiado or Bairro Alto.
- **Budget note:** One major paid site is enough; keep the rest self-guided.

## Day 3: Museum + Local Neighborhoods
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- **Morning:** Choose **one museum**: National Tile Museum or Calouste Gulbenkian Museum.
- **Afternoon:** Graça and Mouraria walk with scenic stops and café time.
- **Dinner:** Traditional tascas in Intendente or Avenida area.
- **Budget note:** Good day to keep spending moderate with one ticket and a relaxed lunch.

## Day 4: Beach Afternoon
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Slow start in the city; optional brunch in Principe Real.
- **Afternoon:** Head by train to **Cascais** or **Carcavelos** for a beach break.
